reporting-org.narrative: Norad - Norwegian Agency for Development Cooperation

description.narrative:
The support to UNICEF will focus on three areas. Outcome 1. Professionalization of the Child Protection Workforce - this will foucs on certificate courses in social work for 300 students, recrutiment of 10 case maangement mentors and partnersning with 4 organisations working on disability and inclusion providing case management for 500 children Outcome 2. Preventing, mitigating and responding to Gender Based Violence - focusing on technical expertise to GBV intergration, and supporting women-led organisations as leads on norms and cultural change Outcome 3. Children and youth in dangerous lives transformative Mental Health and Psychosocial Support (MHPSS) and education programme. TVET support to 500 out of school youth to support effective livelihoods for former child soldiers and other youth in dangerous lives
This support will also include implementation of monitoring and reporting mechanism on Grave Child Rights Violations
